comment: I literally could not say enough good stuff about this dude. Abreu his the best 221 prof by a mile. His classes are so fun. He puts a ton of work into slides and inventing games to play in class. He will have you cracking up at 9am. Explains tough language concepts easily and wants to see you succeed.

He's a great professor. None of the assignments was unreasonably hard. At times, it did seem like there was a lot of work, but it wasn't his fault. He tries to make the class fun, and it was at times. A very strong professor to fill the language requirement, especially if you aren't too confident in your Spanish.

If you have to take Spanish 221, take it with Professor Dixon! I had this class at 7:30 am and 8:00 am, and not once was Prof. Dixon in a bad mood. He showed up to every class with a positive attitude and made the class genuinely enjoyable. Regarding the workload: If you're debating whether to take Spanish 151 first, Just go straight to 221.

He is a nice person and is super sweet. His lectures are interesting but a bit confusing at times. You can get by with just skimming the readings. The bad parts come in the assignments he is not clear with what he wants and it feels like it is just busy work. He does not give out any rubric and we have to basically beg him for direction.

Prof. Abreu is an excellent Spanish instructor who makes 221 engaging and enjoyable. His outgoing and approachable nature combined with deep expertise creates a great learning environment. While he is awesome, he occasionally runs a little over on time during the 45 min classes. Not big but noteworthy. Overall very strong choice for COM2.

Dixon is one of the best teachers I've ever had. He takes LAIS221 - which is a very tough course that meets 7 times a week - and makes it as fun and digestible as it could possibly be. He's a really good guy who will take the time to help you outside of class if you reach out.

I love Dixon. The whole course is in Spanish but he's animated so its easy to understand. As long as you pay attention, do the homework and talk in class you'll do great. Dixon is hilarious, his lectures are engaging and he is so chill. 221 sucks because it meets on Friday but Dixon knows whats up (he makes fun of us for being hungover)

LAIS221 in general is a difficult course with lots if homework, quizzes, and tests. Dixon, however, does an amazing job teaching all of the material contained in the textbook. There is online homework every night, but the workload is manageable. Dixon is very kind and understanding and I highly recommend his class.

LAIS 221 is just not a fun class in general- so much work, lots of tests, and so much memorization. However, if you have to take this class, taking it with Dixon. He is the nicest guy and is so non judgmental- unlike many other spanish profs ive had. Where he can be, hes super lenient with grading and class is pretty fun.

Dr. Abreu lectures with fun, engaging powerpoints (with animations and sound effects) that evidently take a long time to make, demonstrating his dedication to his students and energy. He is a nice professor and knowledgable about Spanish (and other languages too). He is an easy grader and the homework level is reasonable for a 2-unit class.
An amazing professor. If youre taking 221, take it with Dixon.

Dixon is a good choice for professor if you need to take LAIS 221, but this class is just really hard no matter who you take. He does a good job of talking with his hands and helping you understand what he's saying. There's quite a few tests & quizzes, but if you ask then Dixon will tell you specifically what to study. Overall I would recommend him

Great person!! Absolutely adore him. You may have to change your writing style to satisfy him, he tends to be very specific. There was a good bit of reading and writing, but nothing unmanageable. He can be a tough grader, but talk to him and he will clear up any confusion!

Dixon is a great person, but he teaches this class like you're going to be continuing on to higher level Spanish courses. Would be helpful if he realized that most people are in this class to fulfill a pretty useless requirement. Take Woolfolk from all I've heard
Dixon is THE BEST and you can tell he truly loves what he does.

Dixon was a very good professor - funny and always helpful. Took 221 with only 3 years of high school Spanish and, although a lot of work, I enjoyed the class. He spoke Spanish most of the time but made it easy to understand. A good amount of work, but it was worth 2 credits. Would definitely recommend.

Dixon is a nice Professor, who is willing to give you assistance with your papers. However, his class asks you to think critically and prepare for a lot of papers. His guideline is quite abstract, but he will explain more if you seek for help. Such a nice person to have a conversation with, but sometimes the class discussion goes too far

Probably the best professor I've had so far. He was available for me to reach out whenever I needed to consult about anything. The guy gave me clear guidance and suggested creative ways to execute my ideas. His assigned readings were so good that I even keep all the books I bought for his class. Fair person: if you work hard, you get good grades.

Such an amazing character! The type of guy you'd wanna grab a beer with and hang out after class. He's more of a friend than a professor and genuinely cares about the students. Funny but in a cheesy way. Had him for my LLC and FYS class freshman year. (Pro tip: Go to him with a first draft of your paper and he'll literally tell you how to get an A)

Dixon was by far the best Spanish teacher I've had. He really connects with the students and does his best to make the classes fun and interesting. I took him for the Intensive 221 class and although the classes meet every day I always looked forward to going. He's the teacher to take for your gen-ed requirement!!!

Great Professor and a great guy!!! He's the kinda guy you wanna get a beer with, talk and laugh. The course at times may go in an odd direction at times but he connects the content well together. He's a good-grader if you do what's asked. TAKE HIM FOR FYS!!!!

Hilarious and the nicest guy ever. Moves way too fast in class though. My class was about 2 weeks ahead of other classes, and I was very confused by a lot of the material, until he went over it after the exams. Overall, great guy, but there are much easier spanish professors.

Dixon is super nice and funny. However, I am terrible at Spanish (need this class solely to graduate) and got lost along the way multiple times. He would give us extremely hard exams on things we had barely learned. He also went super fast, making my class about 2 weeks ahead of everyone else. Overall, he's nice, but there are much easier teachers.

Dixon is hilarious and makes sure all his students are comfortable. There are frequent quizzes and test, but they are straighforward and he gives study guides for tests. He made the class fun and painless. He always makes sure to stop and explain anything we were confused about. He truely cares about his students and it shows.
Best prof I have taken at UR. Fantastic sense of humor. Participate and the attendance requirement is negligible

Super funny and nice guy who is great at teaching spanish! even though it was at 9am he still made it enjoyable. He thoroughly answers your questions and is good at explaining things. Often includes jokes that make the whole class lef. His tests arent too difficult either. Highly recommend!!
Great professor, very enthusiastic about his class and very approachable. Does his best to make his subject fun.
Makes class fun and interactive; hilarious and not tough at all

Dixon is great! If you study the Vocab before the quizzes you will not miss anything, he tells you what will be on the tests. Most of the class lectures are pretty fun and he likes to tell jokes in spanish. The projects are easy and the tests are easy if you study for them you shouldn't get a B+. Easiest class I've taken here, one of the most fun.

Dixon is awesome. Homework is super easy his lectures are really chill you don't even talk about Spanish half the time making it super easy to participate. His tests are straightforward but there is no partial credit so you have to study but at the end of the day he wants you to do well
He doesn't prepare you for his tests.  Class is really easy and then his tests are pretty hard.  He takes off a lot of points for small errors.
Take him! I feel so prepared for span 221 and he's really chill but his class isn't easy, it's fair. If you work hard you get the grade you deserve!
Tests were A LOT harder than the other professors and it was supposed to be an easy class.

He's pretty difficult. He's a very good easy going teacher, but his tests do not relate to what we learn in class. We were not prepared to take the tests, therefore many of us would end up with a B in what is supposed to be a review spanish class.

He’s a fun, energetic guy who enjoys getting to know students.  His class contains a lot of interaction which simplifies learning Spanish.  I got a better overall grasp of Spanish with Dixon in one semester than with three years of HS Spanish.  He’s a great choice for those that struggle with Spanish and will help you get the grade you want.

Hey is a fun teacher, but doesn't do too much review in class. Seems to be less work then the other 151 classes, and his tests are predictable and relatively easy. Definitely worth taking for this level.
amazing teacher, so chill, really cool guy, tests are a little difficult but class is always fun

Really good CORE teacher.  The discussion is very open and often off topic.  In some of the more difficult readings, Dixon gets a bit confusing and everyone is left wondering what is going on.  Overall though, great teach who is very approachable and fun.
He's nice but a VERY hard grader- even if you are used to getting A's in Spanish don't expect one from him!
Awesome professor!
amazing amazing amazing...learned more in this class than any other at UR
Hot Hot Hot
Great core teacher!
